name: Higher Education
source:
Sam is a 19-year-old, inexperienced, a bit naive, and some may even say conceited girl, ready to take on the world. The story starts when she leaves her home for the first time, moving away to college with her best friend. Follow her on her quest to spread her wings, meet many new people, and help decide her fate. 

[From [url=https://actonbelle.itch.io/higher-education]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Sam是一个19岁的女孩，缺乏经验，有点天真，甚至有人会说是自负的女孩，准备挑战世界。故事开始于她第一次离开家，和她最好的朋友一起去上大学时。跟随她展开翅膀，结识许多新朋友，并帮助决定她的命运。

[来自[url=https://actonbelle.itch.io/higher-education]Itch.io[/url]]
